opening.argument: The presentation asks viewers to pay for Forsage slots and earn through recruitment: “you bring in three people the first two people will pay you.” Its registration slide shows a 0.05 ETH entry payment allocated between X3 and X4, while the matrix structure makes participant placement central to the opportunity. Spillover and recurring ETH income are presented as benefits dependent on a growing participant structure. The speaker urges viewers to share the opportunity, bring prospects to Zoom calls, and act quickly, while describing the possibility of becoming wealthy in a short time. These features establish a recruitment-driven scam solicitation rather than neutral cryptocurrency education.
